program.name: Calm Muscle
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Muscle built slowly: a Pilates series, slow-tempo strength, then a long yin hold.
program.about: Muscle building at a calm pace. Each day starts with a Pilates series, then lifts slowly, three or four seconds down, for the upper or lower body, then ends with long yin holds. Slow reps build muscle and control without rushing. Level II slows every rep down and Level III asks for heavier weights.
program.split: Upper slow / lower slow: Pilates, slow strength, yin
